description: Higher-capacity vision model availability test for the 84-frame SAR sample set. This file preserves one independent Grounding DINO Base result and records why the full batch was not produced.

models_tried.name: NVIDIA LocateAnything-3B hosted demo
models_tried.detail: ZeroGPU endpoint rejected its 240-second requested GPU duration as exceeding the service maximum.

models_tried.name: Grounding DINO Base hosted demo
models_tried.detail: The first inference returned boxes; subsequent batch calls returned event:error with null data. No Hugging Face credentials were configured.

models_tried.name: NVIDIA LocateAnything-3B C++ Q4_K local port
models_tried.detail: Built for aarch64 and loaded a 4.716 GB Q4_K model from /dev/shm. With the playback pipeline paused, one image took about three minutes. Fast mode returned five person boxes, including a duplicate, and no backpacks.
models_tried.license_note: NVIDIA LocateAnything-3B model weights are restricted to non-commercial/research use by the NVIDIA model license.

note: These are machine proposals, not exhaustive ground truth. The result has duplicate/ambiguous boxes and must not be scored as a validated frame.

local_locateanything_trial.note: One duplicate person box at the right edge; no backpack boxes. This does not replace or validate the ground-truth labels.
